author: Pallas, 1773
habitat: 논과 농경지, 바닷가 갈대밭, 바닷가 섬의 풀밭과 덤불
summary: 봄과 가을에 우리나라를 지나가는 드문 나그네새이다. 기온 변화와 여러 개발로 서식지가 사라지고 식용 등을 목적으로 대량으로 포획되면서 개체 수가 심각하게 줄고 있다.

points.ko: 날개 굽이 근처의 넓은 흰 띠(수컷)
points.en: broad white band on the median coverts near the bend of the wing (male)
yellow underparts with a chestnut breast band (male)

sexes.male: 수컷은 얼굴과 멱이 검고 머리꼭대기·등과 가슴의 좁은 띠가 밤색이며, 날개 어깨에 큰 흰 무늬가 있고 아랫면이 샛노랗다.
sexes.female: 암컷은 얼굴이 검지 않고 굵은 담황색 눈썹선과 어두운 테두리의 귀깃이 있으며, 아랫면은 연한 노란색이고 밤색 가슴 띠와 큰 흰 날개 무늬가 없다.

young: 어린새는 암컷과 비슷하나 더 담황색을 띠고 가슴과 옆구리에 가는 검은 갈색 세로줄이 있으며 허리에도 세로줄이 많다. 첫겨울 수컷은 어른 수컷보다 밤색이 적고 아랫면의 노란색이 옅으며, 가슴 띠와 날개의 흰 무늬가 작다.

art.subject: Yellow-breasted Bunting (Emberiza aureola), adult male in breeding plumage (May passage): forehead, face, chin and throat black; crown, nape, mantle and back deep chestnut, the mantle faintly streaked dark; a large white patch on the shoulder (lesser and median coverts) and a narrow white bar below it on the folded wing; rump chestnut; underparts bright yellow, crossed by a narrow chestnut band on the upper breast; flanks streaked chestnut-brown; undertail coverts pale yellowish-white; tail dark brown with white outer feathers; bill pinkish-grey with a darker culmen; dark eye; pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: perched upright on a tall grass stem at a field edge, side view
art.scene: Korean island farmland edge with tall grasses, reeds and shrubs during spring migration in May, bright morning light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male in breeding plumage (spring passage), perched upright on a tall grass stem, side view: black forehead, face and throat, deep chestnut crown, nape and back, broad white band on the median coverts near the bend of the wing, bright yellow underparts crossed by a chestnut breast band, conical bill with a pinkish lower mandible

adult female, perched on a weed stem, side view: strong head pattern with a broad buff supercilium from the bill to the hind neck, dark crown and eye-stripe, streaked grey-brown back, yellow-washed underparts, conical pinkish bill
art.build: Medium-sized bunting, slightly larger than a sparrow, compact, with a rounded head without a crest and a medium-length tail with white outer feathers. Bill conical and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs pinkish-brown. Perches upright on reed stems, tall grasses and shrubs and feeds on the ground among weeds; in flight the white shoulder patch flashes.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow throat, yellow supercilium or black crest — that is Yellow-throated Bunting (Emberiza elegans).
Do not paint a black breast band; the narrow band across the yellow breast is chestnut.
Do not omit the large white shoulder patch, which shows even on the folded wing.
Do not paint a grey or green head; the crown and nape are chestnut and the face is black.
